what_it_is: ArtiFascia® is an absorbable dural repair graft for the repair of cranial dural defects. ArtiFascia® is a highly flexible, easy to handle, non-friable soft matrix composed of synthetic non-woven fibers and a non-porous film. ArtiFascia® readily conforms to the surface of the wound area and is applied to the dural defect by using sutures.

Indications for Use (Describe)
ArtiFascia is indicated as dura substitute for the repair of dura mater. ArtiFascia is indicated for
defects of 25cm2 (3.87 in2) or less in area. For example, 6 cm X 4 cm (24 cm2) would be an
acceptable defect size.
